context: Deploy 2 (quality follow-ons) live verification — PR #303 merge commit 9c27839b on hb-personal-assistant-mcp. Schema migration V124 (search index) on the primary DB + snapshot re-cut + new pa_output_cancel tool.

deploy.note: First migration/snapshot attempt was a no-op (docker run lacked -i, so python3 read empty stdin); corrected with -i + a WAL checkpoint and a :rw source mount (WAL-mode ro-open needs to create -shm, which a :ro mount blocks).

search_latency_3b.note: idx_si_metadata_fts_rowid; EXPLAIN QUERY PLAN uses the index instead of a full scan over ~883k metadata rows. ~100x faster.

cancel_lifecycle_3c.note: pa_output_cancel stages -> cancels a disposable output to a terminal state (reuses `superseded`); previously staged outputs had no terminal path.

disposition: Deploy 2 complete. Search latency ~24s -> <0.3s; staged-output cancellation live; manifest v12/tool_count 147; dual freshness + execution attestation green at 9c27839b.
